title: German Beef Larb Burger
description: A twist on the classic burger, featuring a zesty beef larb patty and topped with roasted flavors.

ingredients.name: Roasted Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced onions roasted at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes

instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat (400°F or 200°C).
Form beef larb meat into 4 patties, about 1 inch thick.
Season patties with zesty bread crumbs and a pinch of salt.
Grill patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast burger buns on the grill or in a toaster.
Assemble burgers with a cooked patty, roasted onions, Thai basil, German mustard, cheddar cheese, lettuce, and tomato.
Note: Make sure to cook beef to an internal temperature of at least 160°F (71°C) for food safety.
